schema.title: Document filing
schema.description: A document arrived by email and the Practice Manager couldn't be certain which patient it belongs to. Nothing is filed in Cliniko until you choose.

questions.label: Where should this document be filed?
options: File on the patient ID below

questions.label: Cliniko patient ID
questions.helpText: Only used with "File on the patient ID below". It's the number in the patient's Cliniko address (…/patients/<ID>).
